messages:
anna: kicking off Deimos-7B onboarding thread. want to confirm canary plan for hosted + dedicated + private. TL;DR: int8 quant, latency SLO 90th < 220ms for 512 tokens, fallback to orca-lite for tail.

miguel: SGTM. main ask: what's the initial traffic % for hosted canary?

anna: start at 0.5% for 1h, then 2% for 2h, then 10% for 6h if smoke OK. dedicated will mirror but with capacity-limited bursts (reserve 2 cards). private customers will be opt-in by invite only.

sarah: perf/quality gates? need explicit numbers for rollout automation.

anna: quality: prompt eval suite (qa_set_v2) pass rate >= 98% (no >3% semantic drift per category). regression alerts on BLEU/ROUGE/ROUGE-L-ish numbers and a custom human-labeled subset. perf: p50 < 95ms, p90 < 220ms, p99 < 500ms. token cost <= baseline*1.15.

ravi: quant plan: try int8 with qk-layer folding + aten kernels, measure perplexity delta and token-level accuracy on the eval set. fallback profile = baseline fp16 model. also run int4 in parallel as a low-cost experiment behind feature flag.

anna: can we wire automatic fallback routing? rule: if p90 exceeds 250ms or error rate >0.5% over 5m, route new requests to orca-lite or fp16 fallback based on route config.

miguel: ops-bot: create canary monitor dashboard and alerts for Deimos-7B hosted canary. include: latency hist, error-rate, throughput, token-cost-rate, quality-regression webhook to eval pipeline.

ops-bot: created dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/deimos-canary and alert: DEIMOS_CANARY_LATENCY_P90 > 250ms for 5m. eval webhook set to https://ci/redwood/evals/deimos.

ravi: smoke tests to run in order: 1) basic text gen (10k short prompts) 2) long sequence stress (2k 4k-token sequences) 3) KV cache consistency check 4) function-calling end-to-end (3rd party toolchain) 5) embeddings parity. include golden prompts and exact-match checks where appropriate.

anna: rollout checklist for engineers: 
- pre-announce to affected customers (support loop)
- tag model-spec: deimos-7b-v1-int8 and deimos-7b-v1-fp16 fallback
- bake quant artifact in staging with seed 42 and deterministic KV caching enabled
- run smoke tests with CI tag and attach logs
- run perf harness: 1000 qps burst simulation, 95th latency should stay under 260ms
- deploy canary on dedicated pool with 2 GPUs and hosted replica set on 3 small nodes
- enable telemetry + eval webhook

miguel: what about warmup and KV cache priming?

anna: warmup script in repo: tools/warmup/deimos_warmup.sh. run for 30m prior to routing production traffic; prime KV with top-50k prefixes from our production n-gram sampler.

sarah: privates: customers on VPC will need rollout playbook and opt-in doc. I'll own the doc. Checklist item: confirm KMS integration and audit-log capture for every inference call (sampling enabled).

anna: good. also add A/B toggle for quality comparisons: route 1% of canary traffic to fp16 baseline for side-by-side evaluation (shadow).

ravi: eval pipeline config snippet: 
```json
{"eval_set":"qa_set_v2","metrics":["semantic_accuracy","toxicity","BLEU","perplexity"],"thresholds":{"semantic_accuracy":0.98}}
```

miguel: incident runbook? if we see semantic drift alert: rollback model -> route 100% to fp16 fallback, pause canary and open incident. owner: eng-ml oncall.

oncall-bot: oncall duty rota: @ravi this week, escalation to @miguel. Pager duty: paged for DEIMOS_CANARY_* alerts.

anna: post-rollout checks (after 24h at 10%): check cost delta, run human eval spot-check for 500 samples, verify no private customer complaints, and confirm SLA telemetry in console.

miguel: one more: tagging and provenance. ensure model card: deimos-7b-v1 has fields: training-data-summary, quantization-steps, known-failures, safety-guardrails. Put artifact in s3://redwood-models/deimos/7b/v1/ with checksum.

ravi: I'll do the quant artifacts and perf harness. PR incoming: draft PR #4287 with scripts + deploy manifests.

anna: great. action items: 
- miguel: dashboard + alerts (done)
- ravi: quant artifacts + smoke harness PR
- sarah: private deployment doc + KMS checklist
- anna: rolling policy config and customer comms draft

miguel: timeline: aim to start canary tomorrow 09:00 PST. any blockers?

ravi: blocked on one perf kernel fix (aten patch) — estimated 6h. will update.

anna: ok let's reconvene 08:30 PST for pre-launch check. :rocket: 

miguel: thanks all.
